comments.author: Dana Whitfield
comments.body: Happens only on board view; list view updates instantly after bulk archive.

content.text: Happens only on board view; list view updates instantly after bulk archive.

Bulk archive from the list multi-select removes cards from the server and shows a success toast, but the archived cards remain visible on the board until the next poll (default 30s) or a manual refresh.

Optimistic removal should drop those card ids from the board store immediately. The bulk archive mutation updates the list query cache but not the kanban column entity map, so the board keeps rendering orphans that 404 when opened.
Clicking an orphan opens an error empty state. Syncing board cache eviction with the same id list passed to POST /issues/bulk-archive will clear them without waiting for poll.
